turns.question: What was our revenue in Q3 2026?
turns.answer: "Q3 2026" can mean the calendar quarter or the fiscal quarter, so here are both: Revenue (EUR) was 17,656.25 EUR for calendar Q3 2026 (2026-07-01 to 2026-09-30) and 19,793.59 EUR for fiscal Q3 of fiscal 2026 (2026-08-01 to 2026-10-31, with data loaded only up to 2026-10-03, so October is incomplete). Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
